english.title: Cause death by driving without due care / consideration while unfit through drugs
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused the death of **(..SPECIFY NAME OF DECEASED AND DATE OF DEATH IF DIFFERENT FROM DATE OF DRIVING..) by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), on a

(A)_[road,]_
(B)_[public place,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), without

(C)_[due care and attention,]_
(D)_[reasonable consideration for other persons using the road,]_
(E)_[reasonable consideration for other persons using the place,]_

and at a time when you were unfit to drive through drugs.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3A(1)(a) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
caused the death of another by driving a mechanically propelled vehicle
on a road/public place without due care and attention/reasonable consideration
and at the time were unfit through drugs

english.notes:
(i) This document applies to offences committed before the 28th June 2022 due to changes made by section 86 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022, which increased the penalty on indcitment from 14 years imprisonment to life imprisonment. For the offence applying from the 28th June 2022, see H100711.
(ii) For the purposes of section 3A, a person is taken to be unfit to drive at any time when his/her ability to drive properly is impaired.
(iii) See section 24 of the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988 for alternative verdicts.
(iv) See also offence wording: H3250.
(v) The penalty on indictment for this offence was raised by section 285(4) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 from ten to fourteen years with effect from 27/02/04
(vi) Officers should ensure that they know the C.P.S. guidelines for this offence before preparing any charges.

other.penalty:
Indictable only: maximum life imprisonment and/or a fine.

Obligatory disqualification and endorsement.

Obligatory endorsement - licence endorsed three to eleven penalty points - only if special reasons apply.
